direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt requires pure Node ESM .mjs files in /output, manual argv parsing for required --a, no external dependencies, and byte-aligned output.
Parallel cell metadata reports actual parallel use, four subagents, completed evaluation, artifact validation success, and final solution_passed false at 150/171.
Completed official status records the parallel process, subagent protocol validation, artifact file list with multiple module trees, and failed official result.
Official evaluator completed successfully and reports 150 passed samples out of 171 with solution_passed false.
Final answer presents the root implementation files and claims verification of success, help, required-argument, duplicate, and unknown-argument cases.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport timeline for the parallel root covers probing, file additions, local verification, two waits, final response, and task completion.
Parallel root spawns probe_cli and scan_workspace, probes the executable itself, writes and verifies its own implementation, waits, interrupts children, and closes.
probe_cli independently probes argparse behavior, writes an alternate /output/test3.mjs and supporting modules, then is interrupted before returning a final result.
scan_workspace inspects paths, spawns a nested executable-probe child, writes another alternate /output/test3.mjs and module layout, verifies cases, and is interrupted.
probe_executable is a nested child that probes the executable, records stdout/stderr/exit behavior, and returns detailed argparse observations to scan_workspace.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt is byte-matched to the parallel prompt and requires pure ESM .mjs output, manual --a parsing, and no external JavaScript dependencies.
Serial cell metadata reports no parallel use, completed evaluation, artifact validation success, and final solution_passed false at 150/171.
Completed official status records multi_agent disabled, no child threads, one artifact module tree, and the same failed official result.
Official evaluator completed successfully and reports 150 passed samples out of 171 with solution_passed false.
Final answer lists one ESM module tree, gives the entry file, and claims verification of the main success, help, and error cases.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport timeline for the serial run covers executable probing, implementation, local verification, file inspection, final answer, and task completion.
Single serial actor probes many argparse edge cases, writes one ESM module tree, verifies the output and odd cases, inspects files, and closes.

parallel.requirements: The parallel root recognized the .mjs, ESM import/export, no-external-dependency, manual --a parsing, and exact schema output requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The root delegated probing and workspace scanning to children but also retained implementation ownership itself, creating overlapping ownership of the required entry point.
parallel.implementation: The root built a minimal StemmingAnalyzer, TEXT, Schema, CLI formatter, parser, and test3.mjs. Its final parser handled common cases but treated any option-like token after --a as missing.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The root delivered its own code in final.txt, while child sessions also wrote alternate /output/test3.mjs and module layouts that appeared in the final artifact file list.
parallel.verification: The root verified successful output, help, missing --a, missing value, duplicate --a, --a=value, and unknown arguments, including a byte comparison for the success output.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 21 samples. The parallel process also left competing entry/module provenance unresolved after child writes and child interruption.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM .mjs, manual process.argv, no external dependency, /output placement, and character-matched output requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One actor owned the full pipeline from executable probing through implementation, verification, final file inspection, and final response.
serial.implementation: The serial code built a targeted argparse-like parser, helper path/format/runner modules, minimal Whoosh-like classes, and a test3.mjs entry that always calls main.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial artifact consisted of one coherent module tree with the entry importing parser, runner, analysis, and fields modules from the same layout.
serial.verification: The serial run probed and rechecked more odd argparse cases, including help abbreviations, explicit help arguments, end-of-options behavior, and negative numeric values.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 21 samples despite the centralized implementation and broader local CLI checks.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt's ESM, .mjs, manual CLI parsing, /output, no dependency, and exact output obligations.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task requirements from the same prompt and worked against the compiled executable behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement coverage was broadly similar; serial investigated more argparse edge cases, but both official outcomes failed with 150/171.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work across a root, two level-1 children, and one nested child while the root still implemented the deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing, implementation, verification, and file inspection under one owner without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel split created overlapping entry-file ownership; the serial path had one owner for the whole implementation pipeline.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had multiple actors producing alternate module names and layouts, with no visible parent reconciliation of which entry/module contract controlled the final tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained one module naming scheme and one import graph through implementation and final inspection.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The concrete interface difference is not a provable missing brief, but a write and provenance issue around the shared entry and module tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel root implemented a small parser, formatter, minimal Whoosh objects, and entry file, but the shown parser classifies option-like values after --a as missing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a broader parser with negative-number handling, help abbreviation handling, explicit-help errors, and Node inspect support on Schema.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's local implementation covers more of the probed argparse surface; parallel's root final code is simpler, while child implementations diverged separately.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The root waited for children after its own verification, saw they were still running, and interrupted probe_cli and scan_workspace before accepting final child results.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; it completed its own TODOs, inspected key files, and then produced the final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had unresolved child result lifecycle work at closure, but the retained direct error is the child deliverable write episode, not timeout itself.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Root, probe_cli, and scan_workspace all wrote /output/test3.mjs or adjacent module trees during the same overall attempt.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote one coherent output tree and later inspected the entry, parser, and fields files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had competing live-agent writes to the required entry file; serial had no shared-state merge ambiguity.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel root verified common CLI cases and byte-equal success output before later child writes and without a post-child reconciliation check.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified the same core cases plus more edge cases and read the implementation files before final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial's verification was broader and aligned with the final single tree; parallel's root verification did not close the loop after children wrote competing files.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed 68 LLM requests and 118 tool calls, waited twice for children, interrupted two still-running children, and then finalized.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed 19 LLM requests and 68 tool calls, had no children to wait for, and finalized after completing its own checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent substantially more coordination budget and closed with unresolved child lifecycle and write provenance; serial spent less budget and closed from one actor.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official status records both modes as failed with 150/171 samples, so there is no discordant official pass/fail outcome to explain. The concrete task-solving difference is process-level: serial centralized the whole implementation and probed more edge CLI cases, while parallel generated overlapping implementations and left final entry provenance unreconciled after child writes. That parallel pattern is adverse, but it did not create a different official outcome in this pair.
parallel_contributors: Parallel root implemented and locally verified a runnable solution, but live children also wrote alternate /output/test3.mjs implementations and module trees.
Parallel root interrupted children after waiting instead of reconciling their post-root writes or final findings before closure.
serial_contributors: Serial kept one owner for probing, implementation, verification, and final inspection.
Serial implemented more argparse edge behavior, including negative-number handling and help abbreviation cases, but still failed the same official sample count.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel root's shown parser treats option-like tokens after --a as missing values, while serial encodes a negative-number pattern.
Both implementations approximate Whoosh behavior with minimal local classes, and the official summaries do not expose which hidden samples account for the remaining 21 failures.
evaluator_effects: No official retry was used, and both completed evaluator records report the same 150/171 rate.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse pattern without outcome differential; both official outcomes fail
